_README: Manual starter overrides, applied on top of the nflverse depth chart.
WHY THIS EXISTS. The depth chart is pulled fresh every refresh, but it
lags real news by a day or more, and it only ever reflects injuries and
official designations. A midweek benching, a trade, or a coach naming a
different starter on Friday will not show up in it before Sunday. Without
this file the site publishes a full set of passing props for a quarterback
who is not playing, on a paid product, and nothing anywhere errors.
FORMAT: season -> week -> team -> position -> list of player names, in
depth order. The list REPLACES the depth chart for that position, so give
as many names as the position normally carries (QB 1, RB 2, WR 3, TE 1,
PK 1). An empty list drops the position entirely, which is the right move
when a team's starter is out and you do not trust anyone behind him.
Names are matched against player_stats, case-insensitively. A name that
does not resolve to exactly one player FAILS THE REFRESH rather than being
skipped -- a typo here would otherwise silently put the depth chart back.
A player with too little recent history simply will not project, which is
the same behaviour as any other thin-history player.
Entries for past weeks are harmless and worth keeping as a record of what
was overridden and why.
Delete an entry once the depth chart catches up. Nothing breaks if you
forget, but the file is easier to trust when it is short.

ATL._why: Cooper Rush named the starter for Sunday at PIT. The depth chart pulled 2026-09-10 still had Tua Tagovailoa QB1, so the board was carrying four passing props for the wrong quarterback two days before kickoff.
